english.title: Fail to surrender a partially revoked firearm certificate
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the holder of a firearm certificate which had been partially revoked under section 30B of the Firearms Act 1968, failed to comply with a notice given under section 30D(2) of the Act by the Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE AREA IN WHICH THE ACCUSED THEN RESIDED..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF NOTICE..) requiring you to deliver up your certificate for amendment within twenty one days.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 30D(3) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
holder of partially revoked firearm certificate
fail to comply with notice
not deliver certificate for amendment within 21 days

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The date of the offence is the twenty second day after the date of the notice; the offence is not a continuing offence.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
48 months
